title: Hearty Italian Chickpea Stew
description: A simple yet flavorful Italian-inspired stew made with chickpeas, hearty Irish stew meat, and a touch of aerated chickpea flour.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, water, flour, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the aerated chickpea flour and continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Note: If using fresh thyme, use 2 sprigs instead of 1 teaspoon dried.
Also, adjust the amount of water according to your desired consistency.
